title: Lumen Current: Signal Garden
tagline: Carry the light through the storm before the garden goes dark.
pitch: You are a living current of light drifting through a dark bioluminescent conservatory. Three signal nodes still flicker; a rising storm pressure drains your stability while drifting thorn-pulses sweep the garden. Reach each node, hold your light steady to ignite it, and restore the signal before the pressure runs out.
coreLoop: Steer the light current across the dark playfield toward the next glowing signal node, dodging drifting thorn-pulses that accelerate as storm pressure climbs, then press Space while inside the node's ring to channel and activate it. Each activation restores a strip of the garden, awards score, and the storm surges harder.

mechanics.name: Light Current Movement
mechanics.description: Top-down free movement with Arrow keys or WASD; the player is a glowing comet-orb with a trailing ribbon. Momentum is light (fast accel, mild glide) so sweeps feel fluid but controllable.

mechanics.name: Node Channeling
mechanics.description: Three signal nodes sit in fixed, generous activation rings (radius ~60px). Standing in a ring and pressing Space (or Enter) channels for ~0.4s and activates the node. Nodes must be activated in any order but only one glows as 'next' at a time; activation requires explicit player input — never automatic.

mechanics.name: Storm Pressure
mechanics.description: A visible stability bar drains continuously over ~75 seconds. Touching a thorn-pulse drains an extra chunk and knocks the player back. At zero stability the run fails.

mechanics.name: Escalating Storm
mechanics.description: Each node activation and each 25% pressure milestone increases thorn-pulse speed, spawn rate and pulse amplitude — a real numeric hazardSpeed value that gates gameplay difficulty, not a cosmetic tint.

mechanics.name: Garden Restoration
mechanics.description: Each activated node ignites a luminous vine circuit that grows across the dark floor toward the next node, visually lighting the player's route — the world itself becomes the progress bar and subtly guides movement.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys / WASD to move; Space or Enter to channel-activate a node; Enter to start a run and to restart after success or failure.
controls.mouse: Optional: pointer position exerts a gentle attraction nudge on the light current; click also channels when inside a node ring.
controls.touch: Optional: virtual joystick on left half, tap right half to channel.

artDirection.mood: bioluminescent conservatory — dark glass-house night, elegant and luminous, never militaristic
artDirection.backgroundFx: Two parallax layers: slow-drifting botanical circuit veins (faint teal filaments) beneath a layer of suspended glowing spores; subtle glass-house reflection sheen with slow color cycling and a soft animated radial gradient that brightens near activated nodes.

audioDirection.musicMood: Ambient, warm synth pads with a soft pulse that quickens as pressure drops

difficulty.start: Calm garden: 2 slow thorn-pulses, generous node rings, stability drains slowly.
difficulty.progression: After each node and each pressure milestone, pulse speed and count rise stepwise (hazardSpeed 60 → 100 → 150 → 210 px/s), pulses emit wider shock rings, and stability drain accelerates.
difficulty.peak: Final stretch: 6+ fast criss-crossing pulses with expanding ring waves; the player must thread gaps to reach the last node with seconds to spare.

winLose.win: Activate all three signal nodes before stability reaches zero — the garden blooms and the run ends in success.
winLose.lose: Stability (storm pressure) is exhausted by time or thorn-pulse hits — the light gutters out and the run ends in failure.

juice.screenShake: Small (≤6px, <0.3s) on pulse hit; medium burst on each node activation.
juice.particles: Burst of teal sparks on node ignite, amber scatter on pulse hit, gentle trailing motes behind the player at all times, petal-bloom particle cascade on success.
juice.hitStop: 60ms hit-stop on node activation completion and on pulse hits for tactile weight.
juice.flash: Brief white-teal flash (alpha ≤0.5) on node ignite; red-amber vignette pulse when stability crosses 25%.

scopeNotes: Cut: any weapons/projectiles, enemies with health or combat, shops/inventory/upgrades/meta-progression, scrolling camera (single 960x540 screen), multi-level structure, pseudo-isometric perspective (pure top-down), touch-specific tuning, narrative cutscenes, boss entities. One screen, three nodes, one pressure bar, one hazard type with escalating behavior.
signatureMoment: Node ignition: time dips for a beat, a chime blooms, and a luminous vine circuit visibly grows across the dark floor toward the next node while the storm answers with a rising surge — restoration and danger in one heartbeat.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: During a run the player orb moves on the top-down playfield in response to Arrow/WASD input, and pressing Space or Enter inside a node ring performs the primary channel-activation action.
During a run the player activates three signal nodes; each activation emits node_activated with the run score increasing (e.g. +100) and the HUD node-progress count incrementing from its prior value.
After the third node activation the game transitions to a success state with a visible 'SIGNAL RESTORED' result screen.
When the visible stability/pressure bar reaches zero the game transitions to a failure state with a visible 'GARDEN DARK' result screen.
Pressing Enter while in a terminal success or failure state starts a fresh run in which node progress is reset to 0 and the game is in the playing state.

During active gameplay the HUD renders at least three non-overlapping, in-bounds regions showing node progress (e.g. 'NODES 1/3'), the stability bar with label, and the score, positioned along the top/bottom edges away from the central play area.
During a run the numeric hazard speed value increases stepwise (e.g. 60 → 100 → 150) as pressure drops / nodes are activated, and thorn-pulse motion visibly accelerates accordingly.
No projectile, shot or weapon event is ever emitted at any point in the game; the event stream contains no projectile_fired events.
No shop, inventory, equipment or meta-progression UI or state exists at any point in the game; the event stream contains no shop_opened or inventory_changed events.

Node activation only occurs as a direct result of a Space/Enter/click channel input; the event stream contains no node_auto_activated events and no node activates while the player is idle outside its ring.

probePlan.scoreEvents: Score increases by +100 for each of the three node activations (event node_activated carries before/after score), plus a small end-of-run stability bonus on success. Under the deterministic verifier sequence: Enter starts the run, directional sweeps carry the orb across node rings at fixed positions (right sweep reaches node A at ~700,300; down-left sweep reaches node B at ~250,420; up sweep reaches node C at ~480,120), and the every-750ms Space presses channel each node as the orb passes through its generous ring, yielding three score_change steps and the success state.

actionPolicy.designBoundary: Required deterministic gameplay must be reachable under generic bounded directional sweeps and ordinary action/pointer input; do not depend on hidden routes, target coordinates, precision-only aim, or verifier-specific backdoors.

scenarios.purpose: prove real successful completion under deterministic active input
prove real timeout/failure independently from success
